digest.component_or_area: Reconciler dispatcher and coordinator cutover for non-create operation families
propositions: Non-create operation families (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict) must route through coordinator and fuse with exact applied/failed/deferred/skipped/recovered tallies preserved.
Per-family internal rollback selector must default coordinator for non-create families with legacy as internal rollback value; dual-send is forbidden.
Remaining matching plans must defer with explicit scope, reason, and retry_not_before metadata while independent scopes continue execution.

All legacy per-mutation guards (abort_check, HEAD-drift recheck, rebar-id audit) and batch preconditions (cross-project, blast-radius) must be preserved at identical execution points in the new routed flow.
Historical replay of 1,200 completed GitHub Actions runs must show zero premature termination before observed successful or partially successful work when tallying only normalized terminal outcomes.
